newsitem.title: USA: Yield quest, U.S. rally boost emerging market debt.
newsitem.headline: Yield quest, U.S. rally boost emerging market debt.

text.p: Rallying U.S. Treasuries and investors' quests for yield continued to bolster emerging market debt on Friday, traders and analysts said.
Quarter-end allocation brought previously sidelined money into play in recent days and should continue to do so over the next several weeks, market experts said.
"What you're seeing is a global reallocation to the emerging markets," said Gary Evans, global debt strategist at UBS Securities. "They're kind of the last spread frontier."
